dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How was your first class, Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ wʌz jʊr ˈfɜːrst ˈklæs, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Challenging! I tried to make the children speak, but they were too shy.
dialogue.reading: ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ! aɪ ˈtraɪd tə ˈmeɪk ðə ˈtʃɪldrən ˈspiːk, bʌt ðeɪ wɜːr ˈtuː ˈʃaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That happens a lot. Have you tried playing games with them?
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈhæpənz ə ˈlɑːt. hæv juː ˈtraɪd ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈɡeɪmz wɪð ˈðɛm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. Do you think it'll work?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. duː juː ˈθɪŋk ɪtəl ˈwɜːrk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Give it a try. When I started, I tried teaching from the book, and the kids were bored.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡɪv ɪt ə ˈtraɪ. wɛn aɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd, aɪ ˈtraɪd ˈtiːtʃɪŋ frəm ðə ˈbʊk, ənd ðə ˈkɪdz wɜːr ˈbɔːrd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'll try using songs, too.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈtraɪ ˈjuːzɪŋ ˈsɔːŋz, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good idea. And remember to stop to rest sometimes. You've been talking all morning.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ənd rɪˈmɛmbər tə ˈstɑːp tə ˈrɛst ˈsʌmtaɪmz. juːv bɪn ˈtɔːkɪŋ ˈɔːl ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're right. My throat is sore.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. maɪ ˈθroʊt ɪz ˈsɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The kids will see that you're making an effort. Just keep going.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈkɪdz wɪl ˈsiː ðæt jʊr ˈmeɪkɪŋ ən ˈɛfərt. ˈdʒʌst ˈkiːp ˈɡoʊɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: One boy stopped talking when I looked at him. I felt terrible.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌn ˈbɔɪ ˈstɑːpt ˈtɔːkɪŋ wɛn aɪ ˈlʊkt ət ˈhɪm. aɪ ˈfɛlt ˈtɛrəbəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Don't worry. Do your best, and he'll start to trust you.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. ˈduː jʊr ˈbɛst, ənd hiːl ˈstɑːrt tə ˈtrʌst juː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks, Daniel. I'll try again this afternoon.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks, ˈdænjəl. aɪl ˈtraɪ əˈɡɛn ðɪs ˌæftərˈnuːn.
